activity_screen.rule_ar: الشركات النشطة مباشرة في الخمور أو التبغ (بما فيه القنب لغير الأغراض الطبية والصيدلانية) أو منتجات الخنزير أو الخدمات المالية التقليدية أو الدفاع والأسلحة أو القمار أو الموسيقى أو الفنادق أو السينما أو ترفيه البالغين (بما فيه خدمات المواعدة عبر الإنترنت)، أو التي تستمد أكثر من 5% من إيراداتها تراكميًا من هذه الأنشطة (بما فيها دخل الفوائد)، غير متوافقة (منهجية MSCI، القسم 2.1).
activity_screen.rule_en: Companies directly active in, or deriving more than 5% of revenue cumulatively (interest income included, measured against total income) from alcohol, tobacco (including cannabis other than for medical or pharmaceutical use), pork-related products, conventional financial services, defence/weapons, gambling/casino, music, hotels, cinema or adult entertainment (including online dating services) are non-compliant (MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology, May 2025, section 2.1).

basis: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology, May 2025 (MSCI Inc.): section 2.1 business activity screening, section 2.2 financial ratio screening (threshold table 2.2.1 for the Index Series), section 2.3 dividend purification. The methodology is approved as Sharia compliant by MSCI's Sharia advisors' committee of Sharia scholars. Encoded from MSCI's own published methodology document, as issue #169's pin gate requires.
name_ar: منهجية سلسلة مؤشرات MSCI الإسلامية — مايو 2025
name_en: MSCI Islamic Index Series Methodology (May 2025) — MSCI Inc.
notes: The encoded screening thresholds are the methodology's Financial Ratio Thresholds (33.33% / 70%). The Entry Buffer (30% / 46%) governs NEW inclusions and the Exit Buffer (35%; none for receivables and cash) governs retention of existing constituents, with the further average-ratio and three-consecutive-review conditions of section 2.2.1; those are index-membership mechanics, recorded per ratio under 'buffers', not screening thresholds.

Sharia-compliant debt and Sharia-compliant instruments are excluded from Total Debt (and from the cash numerator) for a list of markets that includes Egypt (section 2.2). In this engine that exclusion is an input-side adjustment: the snapshot's interest_bearing_debt is the figure after any such adjustment the input pipeline applies.

MSCI's 5% business-activity test is measured against Total Income (total earnings including revenue and interest income, methodology footnote 4); the data model's total_revenue is the input pipeline's corresponding figure, and interest income sits inside non_compliant_revenue.

In index practice MSCI treats securities with insufficient financial information as non-compliant, and exempts Islamic Financial Institutions (Appendix 3 of the methodology) from both screens. Neither index rule is encoded: this engine answers insufficient-data when inputs are missing, and the activity classification is an input.
The retention mechanic based on average ratios over the latest four reporting periods (section 2.2.1) is index maintenance and is not encoded; the engine screens the snapshot's statement period.

capital_component.definition_ar: لا تنشر منهجية MSCI تطهيرًا للأرباح الرأسمالية؛ التطهير المنشور فيها خاص بالتوزيعات فقط (عامل تعديل التوزيعات، القسم 2.3)، فلا يُعلن مكوّن رأسمالي.
capital_component.definition_en: MSCI's methodology defines dividend purification only (section 2.3, the dividend adjustment factor); no capital-gains purification is published, so no capital component is declared.

purification.notes_ar: تطبق MSCI «عامل تعديل التوزيعات» على التوزيعات المعاد استثمارها: العامل = (إجمالي الدخل − (إيرادات الأنشطة المحظورة + دخل الفوائد)) / إجمالي الدخل، ويُحدّث ربع سنويًا (القسم 2.3). حصة التوزيع الواجبة التطهير هي 1 − العامل، أي حصة الدخل غير المتوافق — وهي نسبة التطهير في هذا المعيار. لا تنشر MSCI قيمة تطهير للسهم الواحد.
purification.notes_en: MSCI applies a dividend adjustment factor (DAF) to reinvested dividends: DAF = (Total Income - (revenue from prohibited activities + interest income)) / Total Income, updated quarterly (methodology section 2.3). The share of a dividend to purify is 1 - DAF, i.e. the non-permissible share of income — this rule set's purification ratio. MSCI publishes no per-share purification figure, so per_share_definition is null and no per-share figure is produced.

ratios.label_en: Non-permissible income (incl. interest income) / total revenue

ratios.label_ar: النقد والأوراق المالية ذات الفوائد / إجمالي الأصول
ratios.label_en: Cash and interest-bearing securities / total assets
Accounts receivables and cash / total assets
